Rule.name: JDBC-Target BuildMap
Rule.Description: Builds the account map and adds the roles from IIQAccountRoles as the multi-valued attribute "roles".

Rule.name: JDBC-Target Create
Rule.Description: Creates an account in IIQData and sets the roles.

Rule.name: JDBC-Target Modify
Rule.Description: Modifies an account in IIQData and maintains the roles.

Rule.name: JDBC-Target Delete
Rule.Description: Deletes an account together with its role assignments.

Rule.name: JDBC-Target Enable
Rule.Description: Sets the status of an account to active.

Rule.name: JDBC-Target Disable
Rule.Description: Sets the status of an account to inactive.
